title: Open models week
text:
# Open models week

*2026-11-02*

Three developments this week. [1](<https://models.example.org/posts/tiny-3b>) [4](<https://regulator.example.gov/news/model-reporting>) [7](<https://northwind.example.com/n200>)

**Themes**

- Open models get smaller [1](<https://models.example.org/posts/tiny-3b>) [2](<https://models.example.org/posts/tiny-3b>)
- Rules and hardware catch up [4](<https://regulator.example.gov/news/model-reporting>) [7](<https://northwind.example.com/n200>)

## Lead story: [Lab releases small open model](<https://models.example.org/posts/tiny-3b>)

*Example Models Wire (Copyright 2026 Example Models Wire. Headlines and links only.) · 2026-11-02*

**Why it matters:** Why story s1 matters. [1](<https://models.example.org/posts/tiny-3b>)

- \[1\] Example Lab released Tiny-3B, a 3 billion parameter model. ([source](<https://models.example.org/posts/tiny-3b>))
- \[2\] The model is licensed under Apache 2.0. ([source](<https://models.example.org/posts/tiny-3b>))
- \[3\] **Flagged: unsupported, the source does not support this claim.** Tiny-3B scores 95 on the MMLU benchmark. ([source](<https://models.example.org/posts/tiny-3b>))

## [Regulator opens consultation on model reporting](<https://regulator.example.gov/news/model-reporting>)

*Example Models Wire (Copyright 2026 Example Models Wire. Headlines and links only.) · 2026-11-02*

**Why it matters:** Why story s2 matters. [4](<https://regulator.example.gov/news/model-reporting>)

- \[4\] The Digital Authority opened a consultation on incident reporting for large AI models. ([source](<https://regulator.example.gov/news/model-reporting>))
- \[5\] **Flagged: unsupported, the source does not support this claim.** Responses are due by 15 January. ([source](<https://regulator.example.gov/news/model-reporting>))
- \[6\] The proposal would apply to models trained with more than 10^26 operations. ([source](<https://regulator.example.gov/news/model-reporting>))

## [Chipmaker announces inference accelerator](<https://northwind.example.com/n200>)

*Example Models Wire (Copyright 2026 Example Models Wire. Headlines and links only.) · 2026-11-02*

**Why it matters:** Why story s3 matters. [7](<https://northwind.example.com/n200>)

- \[7\] Northwind announced the N200 inference accelerator. ([source](<https://northwind.example.com/n200>))
- \[8\] **Flagged: unsupported, the source does not support this claim.** Northwind says the N200 delivers ten times the throughput of its previous chip. ([source](<https://northwind.example.com/n200>))
- \[9\] Shipping is planned for the second quarter of next year. ([source](<https://northwind.example.com/n200>))

## Run report

**Claims flagged**

- `s1.c3` unsupported: Tiny-3B scores 95 on the MMLU benchmark. (The passage gives 71, not 95.)
- `s2.c2` unsupported: Responses are due by 15 January. (The passage gives 15 December.)
- `s3.c2` unsupported: Northwind says the N200 delivers ten times the throughput of its previous chip. (The passage says twice, not ten times.)
